channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Palestine weekly wrap: Israel’s ‘quiet annexation’ grows louder
item.description: Al Jazeera cameraman killed in Gaza, West Bank mosques torched, as Israeli officials describe attempt to expand control.

item.title: Bullying investigated after rare Philippines school shooting kills three
item.description: Three students are killed and seven others wounded after a rare school shooting in the central Philippines.

item.title: Conservative radio host defends Trump, says he’s better than Vance
item.description: Prominent conservative radio host, spoke at the International Policy Summit to defend Trump’s handling of the Iran war.

item.title: Ghalibaf: US and Iran can work together to reopen Strait of Hormuz
item.description: Iran’s chief negotiator said the Strait will never return to the way it was before the war.

item.title: Israeli strike kills Palestinian girl on her way to sit exam
item.description: 17-year-old Raghad Ashour was walking to school to take an exam when she was killed in an Israeli strike.

item.title: Iran war live: Ghalibaf says US to release $12bn in frozen Iranian funds
item.description: Trump says released funds will be used to buy US produce, a claim Tehran rejected immediately.

item.title: Video shows deadly shooting in Montreal, Canada
item.description: A police officer, a civilian and the suspected gunman were killed after a shooting in Montreal.

item.title: US eases oil sanctions as Iran denies Vance claim on nuclear inspectors
item.description: Iran's foreign ministry says it made "no new commitments" on nuclear inspections after talks in Switzerland.

item.title: At least 13 killed and dozens injured after Qatar gas explosion
item.description: The city's main liquified natural gas (LNG) processing site suffered a "technical accident" in the Ras Laffan industrial zone.

item.title: Myanmar army killed over 700 civilians in six months, UN says
item.description: The new UN report says the 702 civilian deaths over six months last year included 153 children.
